contexts: Regional heat-health action plan, about 700,000 residents
Activation at two days above 31 degrees
7 activation days and at least 15 other heat-affected days last summer
reading: Activation is associated with fewer heat-related emergency visits, but which components help, and whether a lower threshold adds benefit, is uncertain. Costs rise with activation days while the benefit per extra day may shrink, and public alerts reach low-income neighbourhoods and isolated older people least. Outreach and transport look more promising than alerts alone.
